title: Perses panel preview sample
description: One panel and the data its queries would return, so a panel plugin can be drawn with no datasource, network or Perses server.

timeRange.description: The fixed time range the panel is drawn for. Its end is also what "now" reads in the page.

panel.description: A Perses Panel resource: kind Panel and a spec with display and plugin. Its queries are not needed; the queries array below stands in for them, one for one.

kind.description: The panel plugin's kind, e.g. PulzrDonutPanel.

spec.description: The panel's own options, as in a dashboard.

queries.description: The result of each query, in order. Each replaces one TimeSeriesQuery of the panel, whatever its kind, so a panel's `queryIndex`-style options and per-query settings line up with this array.

stepMs.description: Milliseconds between points. With `points`, the default is the time range spread evenly over them.

values.description: [timestamp in ms, value] pairs; a null value is a gap.

points.description: Values only, the first at the range's start and the rest `stepMs` apart; a null is a gap. Use this or `values`.

metadata.description: The query's metadata as the datasource returns it (a unit, a description, or a matrix for a heatmap).

assets.description: Files the page may request, by URL path, mapped to a file path relative to this sample. `{theme}` in the file path is light or dark. Anything not listed here is blocked, so a map's style or tiles must be supplied this way.
